warm_up:
Activation & Mobilisation Drills:
1 round
Warm Up
10 Scap Push Ups
10 scap Pull ups
10 x Inch Worms
10 I-Y-T-W
10 Leg Raise holding rig
Wrist Mobilisation
Banded Pull Aparts x 10
5 x PVC Pipe Around the world
gymnastics:
Tabata 20 seconds on - 10 seconds off x 5 mins (00:00)
Hollow & Arch Hold
HSW Progression
5 mins - Handstand Kick Up 10 Reps (6:00)
Beginners - Start from a Pike - Pop up with 1 foot only
Aim for soft feet onto wall
5 mins - Nose & toes to wall - Keep in a hollow (11:00)
Accumulate 2 mins total
5 mins - Nose & toes Shoulder taps - (16:00)
Shift Weight between hands
5 mins - HSW Attempts or stay with a prior progression (21:00)
Level 1: Emerging Skill
Level 2: Can get into a freestanding handstand & take a step
Level 3: Can walk 5+ metres
For levels 2/3
Level 2: Walk to or away from wall focusing on stacked hands/shoulders/hips
For level 3 spend a few minutes on each drill then move onto building volume & practice walking / handstand Hold or Partner assisted walking
T2B Bar Progression
1-2 mins False Grip on bar - focus on Knuckles Up (26:00)
EMOM x 2 (29:00)
10 x Beat Swing
EMOM x 2 (31:00)
Bigger Beat Swing - Push Down on Bar
Reach Long in the Arch not back - Dont bend the knees
EMOM x 2 (33:00)
Knees to Chest - Aggressive & Pop - pause at the top
EMOM x 3 (35:00)
Aggressive Knees to chest - with toe flick
EMOM x 2 (T2B Attempt) (38:00-40:00)
While Maintaining Tight Shapes
Level 1: Knees to chest/elbows
Level 2: 1-2 Toes to bar
level 3: 10+ toes to bar
Level 2: Work with a partner and pick a target you can aim for while maintaining tension
Level 3: Practice Hollow & Arch Shapes then Max reps as an E2MOM

hypertrophy.reasoning: Today emphasizes shoulders, core, and pressing patterns; build pulling strength and posterior chain without competing for recovery.
